The left hand carries the bass and harmony in steady steps while the right hand carries the melody, and the sections return and vary so the song is heard whole, never as a fragment. The chant form is stepwise and unhurried, with a melody that moves mostly by step and returns often to its final note, so the line feels sung even on the piano. The left hand carries the bass and harmony in steady steps while the right hand carries the melody, and the sections return and vary so the song is heard whole, never as a fragment. To play it, start slowly, learn each section in turn, then join them at tempo, listening for the melody above the bass. The song lasts 83.5 seconds at tempo and holds 322 notes in total.
